description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a Villain without a finality counter on it.
When the Villain dies, Thunderbolts Conspiracy triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
When the Villain enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.
